gen-gf-goldman-gf-carlito: Goldman spreads its wide, parenthesis-round letters out with plenty of clearance, tall lowercase towering over small capitals. Carlito follows in close-set, friendly sans-serif, a modern counterweight.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-changa: Wide, round and commanding, Goldman stands out at once. It earns its place at big, short sizes, while Changa's sturdy sans-serif lowercase carries on beneath it with iron-cast stature.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-courier-prime: Wide, bold and unmistakably display. Goldman's round forms give way to Courier Prime, a monospace body whose full-width strokes and drafting-pen line feel precise and structured on a long page.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-days-one: Goldman sets wide, round letters with generous clearance up top, over Days One, a sans-serif with rope-ladder spacing. A larger heading size would let that difference show.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-epunda-sans: Epunda Sans opens its sans-serif curves wide, with generous daylight inside every counter and trimmed sidebearings. Yet Goldman handles the commanding display work, its wide, parenthesis-round letters doing what the body text never tries to.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-farro: Farro hums along as a plain sans, its compressed ascenders and stroke contrast of exactly none making a soft, featureless texture. And Goldman supplies the commanding, widely spaced shapes, so the heading stands apart while the paragraph stays quiet.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-fragment-mono: Wide, round and commanding, like open parentheses lined up. Fragment Mono, a monospace body, lays out letters like nails on a ruler, with a round bowl that never swells or thins, while Goldman handles the bold display work.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-geist-mono: Geist Mono reads like code, fixed-width with high lowercase and big side gaps. Goldman does the bold, widely set display work, while the monospace body keeps its line thickness gently monotone.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-genos: Contemporary in feel, Genos presses its sans-serif glyphs so close their edges almost kiss, with a high midline. And Goldman's wide, bold letters give the heading room, so the reading never snags on a closed-up bowl.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-geom: Geom reads with a lofty lowercase band, friendly and contemporary in its sans form. And Goldman's wide, parenthesis-round letters bring a bold, commanding presence that is this pair's strongest card.
